title: Hand-authored shape assignments (matcher seed)
description: Validates curated/shapes/seed-assignments.json -- for 58 real functions, which shape fits and how its slots are filled. Curated because workflow/formal/assign.py consumes it in production as its first matching rule; measured 2026-07-22, removing it changes 26 of those 58 (23 lose their shape entirely, one gets the wrong shape, two get different slot fills). It is also the only place a per-function correction survives --regenerate formal, which rebuilds curated/formal-assignments.json wholesale. Split from the former shapes.golden.json the same day: the expansion each assignment must produce is a test fixture and lives in workflow/formal/testdata/expansions.json, joined on 'ppm:function' and cross-checked by workflow/formal/test_shapes.py. Per-shape provenance moved into shapes.json, so 'why does this shape exist' has exactly one home.

function.description: The function key, as used in the corpus.

shape_ref.description: Id of the shape in shapes.json this function was bound to.

bindings.description: Slot name -> bound value. Every non-optional slot of the referenced shape must appear; expand() substitutes each for its '{{slot}}' token.

extra.description: A deep-merge patch for genuinely one-off, non-reusable quirks on an otherwise-good shape match -- never a holding pattern for a near-miss awaiting a second user (see docs/schema/shape-catalog.md).
